description.text: This entry includes Keratinocyte-associated transmembrane protein 2 found in humans. Functional studies show that KCP2 localises to the endoplasmic reticulum, consistent with a role in protein biosynthesis, and has a functional KKxx retrieval signal at its cytosolic C-terminus [[cite:PUB00138330]].

PUB00138330.title: Keratinocyte-associated protein 2 is a bona fide subunit of the mammalian oligosaccharyltransferase.
